summary: sigmusl on i686 alone, with FXSR and with rach2.nofxsr, on a kernel whose sigframe.c does not fill the ucontext's registers

argv: ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 test-image build/tests/system/harness && ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel tests/musl/sigmusl && ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh image ${WORK} 2 tests/musl/sigmusl

status=0; ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh boot "$1" --net hubport,id=net0,hubid=0 --qemu-arg=-cpu --qemu-arg=max --append 'rach2.rescue' --timeout 30 --steptmo 10 --ok 'SIGMUSL OK' --never 'SIGMUSL FAIL' "expect=Type 'help'" 'send=exec /sigmusl' 'expect=SIGMUSL' 'expect=returning to kernel shell' >"$1/fxsr.out" 2>&1 || status=$?; sed 's/^/fxsr: /' "$1/fxsr.out"; fxsr=$status; status=0; ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh boot "$1" --net hubport,id=net0,hubid=0 --qemu-arg=-cpu --qemu-arg=max --append 'rach2.rescue rach2.nofxsr' --timeout 30 --steptmo 10 --ok 'SIGMUSL OK' --never 'SIGMUSL FAIL' "expect=Type 'help'" 'send=exec /sigmusl' 'expect=SIGMUSL' 'expect=returning to kernel shell' >"$1/x87.out" 2>&1 || status=$?; sed 's/^/x87: /' "$1/x87.out"; [ "$fxsr" -eq 0 ] && [ "$status" -eq 0 ]

faults.name: short
faults.summary: the call of fill_sigcontext taken out of the i686 sigframe.c

lines: fxsr: SIGMUSL FAIL: ucontext cs=0x0 esp=0x0 fpregs=0x0
x87: SIGMUSL FAIL: ucontext cs=0x0 esp=0x0 fpregs=0x0
